title: ArmorFade
description: Customize your own armor visibility with per-slot opacity, hiding, glint control, and multiplayer sync.
body:
ArmorFade is a NeoForge mod that lets players customize how their own armor is rendered.

You can configure each armor slot separately, including helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots. Each part can have its own opacity, visibility toggle, and enchantment glint setting. This makes it easier to show your skin or character style without fully removing the look of equipped armor.

In multiplayer, each player’s settings only affect their own armor. When the mod is installed on the server and on participating clients, players can see each other’s customized armor appearance without overriding anyone else’s personal settings.
